title: Porch Paradise | KEY.co
description_expanded: Porch Paradise is a serene coastal retreat nestled in the heart of Seacrest, perfectly situated between Rosemary and Watersound. This inviting four-bedroom, three-bathroom home offers a harmonious blend of relaxation and entertainment, ideal for creating lasting memories. Spend your days basking by the private pool, unwinding on the spacious screened porch, or biking along the scenic paths of 30A. As the sun sets, gather on the expansive porch for cocktails or cheer on your favorite team in the comfort of the cozy outdoor lounge area. Surrounded by the natural beauty and charm of Seacrest, Porch Paradise offers easy access to the best of 30A while maintaining a peaceful, uncrowded atmosphere. Explore nearby dining and recreation options in Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, or the vibrant Big Chill. With activities like kayaking, canoeing, and swimming just moments away, this home captures the essence of Old Florida charm while providing modern comforts. Porch Paradise is a destination where every moment feels like a celebration of coastal living.

Features: Drip coffee maker Kitchen island Dryer Washer
